question: Can Taiwan broker/branch flow be studied prospectively without conflating execution venue, proprietary activity, selected-universe products, and beneficial-owner identity?

officialSourceTiers.source: TWSE broker buy/sell daily query system
guards: contains proprietary plus brokerage-client trading in the ordinary broker/branch report
same-day current query is not a frozen historical first-known archive
CAPTCHA/current-day interface is not a stable bulk research contract

officialSourceTiers.product: TWSE 買賣日報表(全部不含權證)
semantics: broker/branch data combine proprietary-dealer and brokerage-client transactions
where a broker has head office and branches, proprietary activity is aggregated into head office

officialSourceTiers.product: TWSE The Most Active Stocks and Details of Securities Trade
semantics: does not include proprietary transaction data
remaining brokers are aggregated and totals include branch summaries
officialSourceTiers.guard: Cannot be used as an unbiased full-market denominator.

keyFalsification: Removing proprietary trading does not identify beneficial owners; branch rows still aggregate many unrelated brokerage clients.
A selected active-stock sample can create collider/selection bias because inclusion is conditioned on turnover/attention.
A branch can appear persistent because clients repeatedly route there, because dealer inventory is aggregated at head office, or because of operational routing; none proves one main force.
Comparing concentration metrics across products with different universe-selection rules is invalid without explicit denominator harmonization.
Public current-day query output downloaded later does not prove what was knowable at an earlier decision time.
allowedResearchFeatures: branchNetFlow/ADV within one declared source tier
branchBreadth within one declared source tier
topKBranchConcentration within one declared source tier
headOfficeVsBranchSplit when proprietary-mix semantics are explicit

maturityDecision.reason: Mechanism/source semantics are strong, but an authorized complete-universe replayable source is cost-gated and public selected/current-day alternatives do not satisfy unbiased PIT replay.

status: SOURCE_TIERS_FROZEN / SELECTED_UNIVERSE_BIAS_EXPLICIT / BENEFICIAL_OWNER_UNIDENTIFIABLE / COST_GATED / OUTCOMES_CLOSED / FORMAL_UNCHANGED
exactNext: Do not buy paid data autonomously. If a future authorized full-universe artifact is supplied, first run outcome-blind code-vintage/universe/completeness checks. If only selected active-stock data are available, restrict inference to that selected universe and never generalize to full-market branch alpha.
